The '''First Battle of Iridonia''' occurred during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. It was a victory for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that marked a turning point in the war. Little is known about the battle other than that [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] forces routed a combined [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] and [[Brotherhood of the Sith|Sith]] force. The Republic drove its enemies back, and in so doing, its war effort against the Sith gained significant momentum.
